why_the_three_write_proof_could_not_run: A compound request reaches the sequential executor path only when the
ROUTER can route it and the compound registry declares its shape. The
protected experimental policy covers PAIRS of operations, so a three
operation request is never covered by it; the production policy refuses
an operation that is implemented but not production-enabled. The
production-enabled operations on the resolve_axi backend are clip.delete,
clip.remove, clip.insert, broll.insert, caption.style and reel.opening,
and the only declared compound shape that matches them is
captions on a row named Subtitles. A three-write compound therefore
needs EITHER the shared qualification fixture's Subtitles row (whose
journal belongs to the shared project, so another lane's transactions
would land in it) OR a new declared compound shape and a protected
policy grant - a product decision above this lane.
